material.description: Symptom: pages job 'build the page wasm and maps from main' and ci job 'workspace tests' (test: moba scenario builds an image) fail with: error: unknown doodad kind "pillar-rock-1-skinned" at scenarios/moba/map.osd:18044 (also :18050 and :18056). The same failure is on 9502c2ee (ci run 40152287682, pages run 40152287684), so it predates the units.osd comment commit c229f53f (runs 40152590388 and 40152590420). Evidence: scenarios/moba/assets/doodads.json:1063 keys the kind as pillar-rock-1_skinned (underscore) and :1068 as pillar-rock-1-skinned. Owner: the doodad lane (doodad files are outside the units lane). Related open row: content-doodad-codes-unresolved. Clearing action: make the declared kind match every doodad(...) placement in map.osd, then read CI green on the pushed sha.
material.subject: CI red on main: map.osd places pillar-rock-1-skinned, which no doodad kind declares
material.witness: stale: origin tip 77168a44 reproduced at CI: run 40154918568 success 6/6 (workspace tests and pages map build pass, so map.osd pillar-rock-1-skinned resolves). Read by ci-status dispatch 1792902443029-5097-5dfab4a3a259d156 (first read 1792901101512-5711-e74fc79b5caf9c4d).
